wallpapers.title: One step closer to the summit
wallpapers.caption: Black Crag, Lake District, England
wallpapers.desc: A simple wooden stile leads into one of England's most celebrated landscapes. The Lake District, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is a patchwork of shimmering lakes, rugged fells, and centuries-old stone walls, all shaped by both nature and farming traditions.
